character: A crowded band of rough sailors of mixed ancestries: sunburned humans, an orc, a lizardfolk, a goblin. Scarred, unshaven, grinning, hungry eyes.
wardrobe: Faded sailor's shirts and canvas trousers, red rags tied round arms and heads, cutlasses and boarding axes, crossbows slung across their backs.

full.framing: Group shot, front view. Six boarders crowding a ship's rail, cutlasses raised, grapnel lines thrown over the rail.

portrait.framing: Tight group portrait, square crop, three boarders' faces crowded together filling the frame, cutlass blades raised.

scene.framing: Swarming across a boarding plank between two ships at sea, under a blood-red flag with a black skull.
